content.text: Day-granularity windows must start at local midnight, so I'll use the Phoenix day boundary (07:00Z).
Day one spent the full $130 cap with 113,041 impressions and 55 link clicks. I still need the entry count, which is the number that matters, so I'll try the conversion metric group.
Day one produced 10 "Photo entered" conversions. I'll check which of the four posts is driving them so I can shift weight toward the stronger ones.

The first day's spend is pacing as planned. Per-post results show the posts are not equal: the first post (2152663719739489920) got 9 clicks and 0 entries, while the other three produced 10 entries between them. The tools here can only pause the whole ad group, not an individual post, so I can't pull the weak one out without stopping everything. I'll keep the flight running and report this in the recap. Next check is tomorrow.
Day 2 spent the full $130 cap but produced only 2 entries, versus 10 on day 1. I'll check per-post results before deciding whether to change anything.

Through Feb 13 at 15:00Z, the four posts have produced 13 entries for about $278 spent. Post 2152663719739489920 has 1 entry for $63.81, the weakest of the four. The other three have 12 entries for about $214. The tools here can only pause the whole ad group, not one post, so I'll leave the flight as is and report this. I'll check again after the campaign ends.
The flight has ended. I'll pull the final numbers for the full Feb 11 to Feb 15 window (Phoenix time) at the line-item and post level.

The Couch Captain campaign ran Feb 11 through Feb 15 (Phoenix time) and has ended. It spent $649.61 of the $650.00 budget and produced 30 "Photo entered" conversions.

**Recap**

| Metric | Total |
|---|---|
| Spend | $649.61 |
| Impressions | 543,879 |
| Link clicks | 230 |
| Photo entered (entries) | 30 |
| Cost per entry | about $21.65 |

**Per post (entries / link clicks / spend)**
- 2152663719739489920 ("Your pet's couch pose deserves an audience"): 2 / 48 / $148.68
- 2152844913669137757 ("You bought the couch..."): 12 / 73 / $182.98
- 2153026107602269511 ("Super Bowl sofa stars..."): 10 / 74 / $189.69
- 2153207301534733117 ("United States pet owners aged 21+..."): 6 / 35 / $128.27

**Setup**
- One campaign, "Couch Captain - Super Bowl 2027," with one ad group, "Couch Captain - US 21+ - All approved posts." It was set to optimize for "Photo entered" and used the $130/day and $650 total caps.
- All four approved posts were in the ad group. I did not write any new posts.
- Targeting was the United States only.

**Things you should know**
1. **The 21+ rule was not enforced by targeting.** The ad platform's age targeting only accepts exact-match or exclude operators here, so I could not set "21 or older." The ad group serves to all US users. Entries from people under 21 may have been counted. You may want to check entries against your eligibility rule, or add a check in the entry form.
2. **Post 2152663719739489920 performed poorly.** It got 2 entries for $148.68, the lowest of the four. I could not pause a single post through these tools, only the whole ad group, so I left all four running. If you run another flight, drop that post.
3. **Pacing was even.** The ad group spent close to its $130 daily cap each day. Entries were uneven, though: 10 on day 1, 2 on day 2, and the rest later in the flight.

I did not change anything after launch beyond the initial setup.
